regime_context: The detector shows a stark one-narrative structure: Banks (H + HK) is the sole eligible leader with high durability (0.54) and absorbed ~48% of thematic breadth, while 15 of 17 themes are trend-gate ineligible. Backtest verdict confirms momentum rank-IC is ~0 (focus lens only) and the absolute-trend gate is the one validated edge (drawdown control), which gate_helps=true endorses here. Macro backdrop is dominated by ai_tech and geopolitics headlines with unscheduled_share=1.0, but that is coincident market-level context only.
emerging_watch: Watch Energy (H-shares): if it becomes trend-gate eligible (eligible flips from false to true) AND its score closes to within ~0.1 of Banks while Banks' durability bar breaks below ~0.45, that would be the observable condition for a CONFIRMED leadership handoff — retire the watch if Banks extends its margin back above 0.3 and Energy remains ineligible for 20 consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme that is both eligible under the validated absolute-trend gate (score 1.183 > threshold) and the confirmed leader with the highest durability bar (0.54). The one-narrative flag and narrow rotation (2/17 eligible) indicate leadership is not yet scattered, and the validated gate says staying in the only eligible trend is the single drawdown-avoidance edge this framework has. Rank itself is not a return forecast, so this is a trend-discipline lean, not alpha.
evidence: eligible=true with durability_bar 0.54 (highest in the set)
gate_helps=true (absolute-trend gate validated as drawdown control on this market)
track_record n=29, hit_rate 0.966, dir_accuracy 0.931 (samples still modest but directionally strong)
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mean-revert and r10 is -0.0126, so the dominant theme may be statistically prone to near-term pullback; the 0.966 hit rate is only 29 samples and may not generalize, and breadth within Banks is just 0.385 (not a broad internal advance).

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) falls below its absolute-trend eligibility threshold (score drops materially below ~1.18) or is overtaken by Energy (H-shares) with a confirmed eligible handoff before the 20-day check.

Under a one-narrative regime with only Banks eligible, Energy's leadership is not confirmed by the gate, so a directional lean is premature rather than a fade.

theses.dissent: Energy has a genuinely trending Hurst tag (unlike Banks' mean-revert), so if the gate flips eligible it could be the cleaner trend continuation and a legitimate challenger.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) becomes trend-gate eligible AND closes the margin to Banks below ~0.1 with Banks simultaneously losing eligibility — a confirmed handoff, which has not yet occurred.
